mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, item_id, sku_id, item_title, quantity, unit_price, total_amount ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{itemId}, #{skuId}, #{itemTitle}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, item_id, sku_id, item_title, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, created_at FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
